title: Astro Portal session event payload: exposure_change
description: A change of the exposure time during the session, found by Astro Sync in the frames: the exposure went from `fromSeconds` to `toSeconds`. The instant is the event's own `recordedAt` (the first frame taken at the new exposure). The sentence the person reads is composed by the application from these fields. See session-events.md.

description.description: Optional sentence for an application that does not know this type: it shows it as an ordinary report. The applications that know the type compose their own sentence, in the person's language, from the structured fields.
